name: MO Loan borrow burns pair reserves and prices collateral from the manipulated spot
summary: Loan.borrow pulls MO collateral, pays USDT valued at the MO/USDT pair's spot reserves, then has the pair burn 90% of the borrowed MO amount from its own reserves and sync, raising the MO spot price; a duration-0 order can be redeemed immediately for full collateral with zero interest. The attacker looped borrow/redeem to ratchet the MO price, then borrowed against the inflated price and sold MO into the depleted pair, draining USDT from the Loan contract and the pair.
notes: Immutable Loan runtime contains the self-referential reserve burn, spot-price valuation and zero-interest immediate redeem; post-deployment owner calls only changed supplyMaxAmount.

Two USDT components: net Loan contract depletion (331,860.835974) and net MO/USDT pair depletion (414,331.166143) in extraction transactions source-2 and source-6. MO burned from the pair and MO moved between the parties are not valued (the post-exploit MO price collapsed), so the USD figure is a lower bound on LP loss. Attacker seed funds (2,100 USDT into its contract and small USDT additions to the pair in its getReward calls) are not counted as victim loss.
